title: REPORT on the implementation of the common security and defence policy – annual report 2024
part_text: 17. Is concerned about the EPF, which has made a fatal error in supporting the provision of military capabilities and training to the Ukrainian Armed Forces, while facilitating coordination for all stakeholders through the clearing house mechanism within the EU Military Staff; deplores the establishment of the dedicated Ukraine Assistance Fund under the EPF and calls for the complete cessation of financial resources for military assistance to Ukraine; recognises the Hungarian Government’s peace-making efforts and understands its veto on the extension of the EU’s sanctions renewal period and the EPF military support to Ukraine, including the agreed reimbursement to EU Member States for the military aid they have delivered; expresses its deep appreciation that the veto by the Hungarian Government has blocked the opening of a new tranche of expenditure to support the Ukrainian Armed Forces and has prevented wasting EUR 6.6 billion in partial reimbursement to the EU Member States providing military support to Ukraine; urges the Council and the VP / HR to retain blockages and these funding cuts;
